chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Al-Jawhari, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
And they ask you to inform them: Is it true?
He عليه السلام said: "What is being said regarding Ali عليه السلام."
Say: Yes, by my Lord, it is surely the truth, and you will not escape.

key_terms.أَحَقٌّ: is it truly real and established
key_terms.بِمُعْجِزِينَ: able to escape, thwart, or render powerless
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Ali عليه السلام, identified here as the subject of the verse's interpretation
key_terms.لَحَقٌّ: surely the truth; firmly and certainly true
key_terms.وَيَسْتَنْبِئُونَكَ: they ask you to inform them or seek clarification from you

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 10:53 interpreted in Shia hadith regarding Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration presents an interpretation of the verse as referring to the truth of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام and his wilayah. It frames the Qur'anic affirmation as a decisive declaration that this matter is true and cannot be evaded or frustrated.
